description: {{ORG}} PM shared memory system — PARA-structured Obsidian vault, external business brain for {{ORG}} product managers ({{PRODUCT}}).
_qmdComment: Changed 2026-10-29 from the named index 'memory_system' to qmd's default index, so bare `qmd` CLI calls and the MCP server read the same store. The canonical qmd config (collection, ignores, per-folder contexts) lives in ~/.config/qmd/index.yml, outside the repo; see 3_RESOURCES/AI Skills/.agents/skills/qmd/SKILL.md for how to rebuild it.

vaults._comment: Two vaults, same PARA shape (2026-11-13). Paths in docs and skills are relative to the shared vault root; private paths start with the mount name.

shared.holds: company context, project status, concepts, processes, engine

private.holds: people and coaching, career, personal areas and projects, inbox, raw Slack pulls, own actions
